description: Report actual performance metrics for a blueprint. The system auto-resolves predicted targets from the blueprint and returns deviation analysis. Supports multiple metrics in one call. Use this after implementing agents to track whether they hit their success criteria.

customerOrgId.description: Customer organization ID (UUID). Required for partner users accessing a customer org.

metrics.description: One or more metrics to report

baselineValue.description: Pre-agent baseline value, if this is the first measurement

measuredAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when measured. Defaults to now.

metricName.description: Metric name as defined in the blueprint (e.g., "Incident Resolution Time", "ROI")

metricType.description: Metric category. Auto-detected from blueprint if omitted.

notes.description: Context about how the measurement was taken

name: report_metric
